name: User Chooses Main Menu Instead
goal: User opts for 'Main menu' instead of requesting the employment letter; bot redirects accordingly.
constraints: Employee details are valid. User selects 'Main menu' from options.

phases.description: Bot fetches and displays employee details.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot displays employee details and presents options.
Bot marks task as complete, redirects to main flow, and displays the list of available services as specified.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
